metadata.gitb:name: [eu.electronics] Validate an uploaded Digital Product Passport
metadata.gitb:description: Upload a passport as JSON-LD and validate it against the "eu.electronics" shapes (EU Electronics — ESPR Electronics Acts). The passport's own @context is resolved from ref.openepcis.org, so it must reference the published contexts — the same condition a real consumer of the passport faces.

verify.desc: Validate against the eu.electronics SHACL shapes

failure.default: "The passport does not conform to eu.electronics. The failed step's report lists every violation."
